decisions.decision: Town Manager Lemieux will write a letter of support to MRPC for TIP Amendment #3 (Route 13/Chase Road resurfacing project).
decisions.quote: ms. lemieux will write a letter of support to mrpc for tip amendment #3

decisions.decision: The debt exclusion road list is to be updated at future intervals and provided to the Board twice annually.
decisions.quote: mr. toale asked for the debt exclusion road list to be updated at future intervals and provided to the board twice annually.

decisions.decision: Notices of the paving schedule will be placed on public access and the website, and mailed to affected residents.
decisions.quote: in order to inform residents of the paving schedule, notices will be placed on public access, the website and notices will be mailed to affected residents.

decisions.decision: Ms. Lemieux, Mr. Burney and Mr. Rodriquenz will work on a draft Complete Streets policy and present it at a future meeting.
decisions.quote: ms. lemieux, mr. burney and mr. rodriquenz will work on a draft policy and present at a future meeting.

decisions.decision: The plan is to issue five Requests for Proposals, one for the sale of each town-owned building.
decisions.quote: the plan is to put out five requests for proposals (for sale of each building).
